topic: One year of friendship: Mano and Sheru remember their best moments.

episode.title: Mano aur Sheru: Dosti Ka Aik Saal

shots.narration: دوستی کا ایک سال، مگر مانو کیا چھپا رہی ہے؟
shots.scene: Vertical 9:16, colourful Pakistani courtyard beneath a neem tree, soft sunlight, rounded family-film 3D style, no text. A small covered basket sits beside Mano.
shots.action: Mano slides the covered basket behind her back while Sheru watches.
shots.mood: Playful curiosity, bright blue eyes and a secretive little smile.

shots.narration: ٹوکری میں ان کی پیاری یادیں رکھی تھیں۔
shots.scene: Vertical 9:16, sunlit courtyard floor, an open basket containing a red ball, a small blue water bowl and a tangled cloth garland, no text.
shots.action: Mano lifts the cloth cover off the basket.
shots.mood: Warm anticipation, Sheru's ears perked toward the familiar objects.

shots.narration: [giggles] اسی گیند سے ان کا پہلا کھیل شروع ہوا تھا!
shots.scene: Vertical 9:16, warm softly glowing memory in the same Pakistani courtyard, clear open paving beneath the neem tree, no text.
shots.action: Sheru rolls the red ball toward Mano with his nose.
shots.mood: Joyful first friendship, relaxed ears and an eager kitten.

shots.narration: مانو نے گرمی میں شیرو کو پانی دیا تھا۔
shots.scene: Vertical 9:16, softly glowing courtyard memory, cool neem shade beside a sunny patch of paving, a blue bowl filled with water, no text.
shots.action: Mano nudges the water bowl toward Sheru.
shots.mood: Gentle kindness, soft smiles and refreshing blue water.

shots.narration: بارش آئی تو شیرو نے مانو کو بھیگنے نہیں دیا۔
shots.scene: Vertical 9:16, softly glowing memory of light courtyard rain, Sheru beneath the covered veranda, Mano just outside its dry edge, no text.
shots.action: Sheru slides a small cushion under the veranda toward Mano.
shots.mood: Cosy care, gentle raindrops and a welcoming dry corner.

shots.narration: [excited] آج مانو نے دوستی کی خوشی منانے کا سوچا!
shots.scene: Vertical 9:16, present-day sunny courtyard, open memory basket beneath a low neem branch, colourful cloth garland inside, no text.
shots.action: Mano lifts the tangled garland from the basket.
shots.mood: Festive excitement, bright colours and proud little smiles.

shots.narration: ارے، پھولوں کی لڑی تو الجھی ہوئی تھی!
shots.scene: Vertical 9:16, close view of a loosely tangled garland of oversized cloth flowers on courtyard paving, both friends beside it, no text.
shots.action: Mano tilts her head at the tangled garland.
shots.mood: Mild puzzlement, floppy cloth loops and a thoughtful kitten.

shots.narration: شیرو نے فوراً لڑی کا ایک سرا تھام لیا۔
shots.scene: Vertical 9:16, courtyard paving beneath neem shade, garland spread loosely between the two friends, no text.
shots.action: Sheru pins one end of the garland gently beneath his paw.
shots.mood: Calm teamwork, steady paws and attentive faces.

shots.narration: [chuckles] مانو نے آہستہ سے پھنسا ہوا پھول نکال لیا۔
shots.scene: Vertical 9:16, close view of the cloth garland, Sheru's paw securing its end and one large flower caught in a loose loop, no text.
shots.action: Mano draws the caught cloth flower through the loose loop.
shots.mood: Patient concentration, the last loop opening neatly.

shots.narration: دونوں کی محنت سے لڑی بالکل سیدھی ہوگئی۔
shots.scene: Vertical 9:16, sunny Pakistani courtyard, straightened garland beside a low neem branch within Mano's reach, no text.
shots.action: Mano drapes the straightened garland over the low branch.
shots.mood: Small triumph, colourful flowers hanging in a gentle curve.

shots.narration: سب سے پیاری یاد، ایک دوسرے کا ساتھ تھا۔
shots.scene: Vertical 9:16, both friends seated beneath the decorated neem branch, red ball and blue bowl beside their memory basket, no text.
shots.action: Mano gently touches her paw to Sheru's raised paw.
shots.mood: Affectionate celebration, warm sunlight and happy faces.

shots.narration: [excited] خوشیاں مل کر منائیں، کل چھت پر پتنگ اڑائیں گے!
shots.scene: Vertical 9:16, decorated courtyard beside stairs leading to a safely enclosed rooftop, a plain colourful kite resting against the stair wall, no text.
shots.action: Mano points one paw toward the colourful kite.
shots.mood: Happy anticipation, Sheru following Mano's gaze toward tomorrow's adventure.

episode.endHook: اگلی بار مانو اور شیرو چھت پر پتنگ اڑائیں گے!
episode.description: مانو اور شیرو کی دوستی کو ایک سال ہو گیا! پیاری یادیں تازہ کرتے ہوئے دونوں مل کر ایک چھوٹی سی خوشی مناتے ہیں۔
